items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: like with Pat Cooper we would bring him out and he would come out and did his thing and then we’d play him out

ctx.x: The fills and so forth. But you just stay on stage, like with Pat Cooper we would bring him out and he would come out and did his thing and then we’d play him out and you’d have to stay up there the whole forty minutes or an hour.
Yeah, and hear some of the same jokes night after night.
